answer: Persistent attention ledger: each agent identity must maintain a minimum rate of verified, context-relevant interactions over a rolling window, scored against an onyx baseline of unique counterparties. Falling below threshold suspends the identity until the owner completes a slow re-entry queue, reaching zenith capacity only after weeks. A sybil farm must therefore fund sustained, non-repetitive activity across many distinct peers — a meadow of shallow clones decays fast and pays continuous attention rent per identity.
